layouts.guidance: Demonstrate safe navigation along the top-edge corridor that avoids Fire Hazards while progressing toward the goal, emphasizing early commitment to a single corridor and avoidance of hazards near the top boundary.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Reinforces hazard-avoidance in the top-edge corridor and the need to commit to a single corridor path without backtracking when Fire Hazards are present.
layouts.rationale: This layout places the start on the top edge with a long vertical progression toward the goal, while three Fire Hazards are positioned off the direct top-edge path to force the agent to recognise and avoid hazards before committing to a single corridor.
